pages.name: page_activity
pages.title: Your Climate Action Activity
pages.description: What your group plans to do, where, and what the money will pay for.

elements.name: ixo:serviceType
elements.title: What Climate Action Approach do you intend to do
elements.description: Pick the one that fits your plan best.

choices.text: Map and Clean campaign — before and after pictures on maps, with data on how much waste you collected and where it went.
Plant and map a tree — plant trees, map them, and track how they grow. This can become a blockchain-backed Verifiable Credential for carbon financing.
Mapping water access to communities — map which water points work and which do not.
Illegal Waste Dumps mapping — youth-led mapping of illegal dumping sites, to give city authorities real evidence.
Wetland Encroachment mapping — map where farming is pushing into protected ecosystems.
